High-resolution (600 dpi) version of [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]’ print-ready recreation of [[Dannik Jerriko]], from the [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. Its text begins with an asterisk power formula, as on the [[Dannik Jerriko (PC Errata)|June 2017 PC partial]] and [[Dannik Jerriko (PC Errata 2)|2018 PC face]]. The [[Dannik Jerriko (Errata)|1998 Glossary entry]] instead renders “W Power” after the once-per-battle clause.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Dannik Jerriko _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1j9wWlEHp2xP42Ln-ArsXwe3V62x3gwI5/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Dannik Jerriko _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,176 bytes, SHA-256 <code>b4bcaf92f11e2d0e09b34379a323fbb1819fe141d1f7240f2ae563658de2d6a1</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.



Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
